newsitem.title: PERU: Peru sells Chavimochic farmlands for $14 mln.
newsitem.headline: Peru sells Chavimochic farmlands for $14 mln.

text.p: Peruvian privatization officials said Thursday they had successfully sold a first lot of the Chavimochic agricultural lands for about $14 million.
The first 3,011 hectares of land, in the La Libertad region 375 miles (600 km) north of Lima, were sold Wednesday to private investors in 18 sections.
The remaining 9,739 hectares will be offered in three more sales scheduled for Thursday, Friday and Monday.

The government's privatization head, Jorge Gonzales Izquierdo, said the development of the lands by the private sector should create 16,000 new jobs. He added that 90 percent of the bidders were Peruvian, although there were some U.S., Japanese and Chilean concerns interested.
